# swarmops queue status

List the queue's entries: REF's, or every ref's, open ones in queue order first.

```yaml
title: "swarmops queue status"
description: "List the queue's entries: REF's, or every ref's, open ones in queue order first."
group: "queue"

mutates: false
identity_required: false
mcp_tool: "queue_status"
envelope_op: "queue_status"
exit_codes: [0]
errors: []
syntax: "swarmops queue status [OPTIONS] [REF]"
```

## Syntax

```text
swarmops queue status [OPTIONS] [REF]
```

## Required arguments

None.

## Optional arguments

The command also takes the [global options](../cli.md#global-options).

### `REF`

Syntax: `<REF>`.

Only this ref's queue.

### `--entry`

Syntax: `--entry <ID>`.

Only this entry, by its id.
